targetSentences.oldKo: 이렇게 길을 이어 가다가 맨 아래 줄에서 다시 내려가려는 지점이 나오면, 그 끝을 출구 방으로 정합니다.
targetSentences.newKo: 이렇게 길을 잇다가, 맨 아래 줄에서 아래쪽으로 내려가려는 경우가 나옵니다. 그때는 더 내려가지 않고, 현재 방을 출구로 정합니다.
targetSentences.oldEn: When the path attempts another downward step from the bottom row, that endpoint becomes the exit room.
targetSentences.newEn: As the route grows, it may attempt another downward step from the bottom row. Instead of going farther down, the current room becomes the exit.
targetSentences.reason: Separate the bottom-row condition and resulting exit assignment into two complete sentences, preserving condition-before-result and no fixed exit coordinate.

targetSentences.oldKo: HD 화면에서도 보물을 든 캐릭터가 발판을 지나 출구 근처까지 내려오지만, 굴러오는 큰 바위에 부딪혀 쓰러지죠.
targetSentences.newKo: HD 화면의 캐릭터는 보물을 들고 발판을 지나, 출구 근처까지 내려옵니다. 그런데 굴러오는 큰 바위에 부딪혀, 결국 쓰러집니다.
targetSentences.oldEn: In the HD footage, the character carrying treasure passes the ledges and descends near the exit, but is struck by a large rolling boulder.
targetSentences.newEn: In the HD footage, the character carries treasure past the ledges and descends near the exit. Then a large rolling boulder strikes the character, who falls.
targetSentences.reason: Separate observed descent and the fatal boulder collision into natural complete sentences, retaining failure near the doorway rather than success or resurrection.

synthesisUnit: Each replacement is one continuous two-sentence component, preserving component IDs. This is a canonical script revision, not punctuation-only engine input.
qualityPolicy: Same approved voice, natural speed/PCM and numerical thresholds. Check each target as a full component plus all paragraphs and joins. Do not make short sentences artificially long; use actual ASR words and later moving-footage sync.
